environment.description: AWS Lambda function deployed with Secrets Manager dynamic credential injection via Lambda extension layer (arn:aws:lambda:us-east-1:177933569100:layer:AWS-Parameters-and-Secrets-Lambda-Extension:4). Upload credentials are vended by a custom Secrets Manager rotation Lambda (rotation interval: 60 seconds) that provisions STS session tokens with a MaxDurationSeconds of 60. The rotation function calls sts:AssumeRole with a 60-second DurationSeconds and writes the temporary credentials to the secret value. The S3 bucket has a bucket policy with a condition key requiring aws:TokenIssueTime to be within 60 seconds of the request time (NumericLessThanEquals on epoch delta computed via a bucket policy variable). Additionally, the S3 bucket has Object Lock in GOVERNANCE mode with a 1-day retention, preventing immediate object deletion or overwrite, and a lifecycle rule that transitions objects to DEEP_ARCHIVE after 1 hour pending security scan by a separate EventBridge-triggered scanner Lambda. The API Gateway has a request validator that enforces a maximum content-length of 10MB via integration request mapping template.

config.credential_source: AWS Secrets Manager with custom rotation Lambda
config.lifecycle_rule: transition to DEEP_ARCHIVE after 1 hour pending scan
config.scanner_lambda: EventBridge rule on s3:PutObject triggers malware/content scan
